question: How can I make room for a creative hobby?

reading.title: Making Space for the Muse
reading.introduction: It is entirely possible to carve out a little sanctuary for your imagination without completely burning down your existing routine.

cards.title: The Fool
cards.interpretation: You are standing at the edge of something new, feeling that familiar tickle of curiosity about what you might create if you just gave yourself permission.
cards.pop_culture: Elsa stepping out onto her ice balcony in Frozen, ready to build something entirely her own.

cards.title: Ace of Wands
cards.interpretation: A fresh spark of creative energy is trying to elbow its way into your schedule, demanding that you notice it amidst the daily grind.
cards.pop_culture: Andy Dufresne finally reaching the end of his tunnel in The Shawshank Redemption, blinking into the sudden rush of fresh air.

cards.title: Strength
cards.interpretation: Meet the inevitable friction of changing your habits with patient gentleness rather than harsh self-discipline or brute force.
cards.pop_culture: Ted Lasso patiently baking shortbread biscuits for his boss, trusting that small, kind gestures will eventually win the day.

reading.next_step: Set a timer for ten minutes today, close all extra browser tabs, and just play with your new creative medium before your inner critic even realizes what is happening.
